excerpts.author: parithosh

The genesis configs for `withdrawal-devnet-1` are now out: https://github.com/ethpandaops/withdrawals-testnet/blob/master/withdrawal-devnet-1/custom_config_data

Genesis is tomorrow (22nd dec) @  12PM CEST, Capella is at epoch 40 (~4PM CEST). We do have some extra validator keys available if any client team wants to take part. This won't be a fully public testnet, it'll be semi-public, some external entities will be running validators to test features. Depending on the stability of this network, we'll announce another fully public network soon 😄 

Tooling links can be found here: https://withdrawalsdevnet1.ethpandaops.io/
